findings.initialReport: The reviewer identified a possible source row split after changes during a stop. The initial wording overstated which version fields were in the key; direct source read confirmed the actual drifting field was locator.
findings.resolution: Removed locator from sourceKeyFor; key is schema/domain/authority/namespace/subject. Pin/profile changes advance the subject row and retire prior generations. Store regression checks same source key, one source row and retired old generation; owner restart regression checks one source row.

findings.initialReport: The Gateway identity projection and persisted service scope omitted sessionId, so a rebuilt physical generation of the same logical session could inherit enable scope.
findings.resolution: Propagate sessionId, require it to enable, compare it for every request, and deny background owner snapshots whose physical session generation differs. Search/reconcile/disable generation drift negative cases added.

closureMessages.text: 我会只重读你点名的 `sourceKeyFor` 20 行和 `observe` 的 `sourceChanged/advancesIntent` 段，核对同 source 变更是否确实复用 row；若我上一条读错，会直接撤回 P2-1，不扩展新面。
我只复核这两个修复点：`sourceKeyFor` 是否已去掉 `locator` 且 `sameSource`/intent 能处理 locator 变化，以及 `sessionId` 是否进入 `readIdentity`、持久化 selection 和 `assertScope`，并检查对应断言是否覆盖。不会运行测试或扩大扫描。

**P2-1 纠正：closed，撤回上一轮该 finding 对当前候选的结论。**

当前 `sourceKeyFor` 已改为只包含：

`"ProjectionSourceKey/v1" + schema + domain + authorityId + namespaceId + subjectId`

见 [projection-store.ts](</C:/Users/27933/.codex/worktrees/project-rag-longterm-20261109/ClawX/openclaw_runtime/src/knowledge/retrieval/projection-store.ts:131>)。`locator`、revision、digest、policy 不再参与 row 分裂。

`observe` 的同一 row 路径已确认：`sameSourcePin()` 检测 source pin 变化，`advancesIntent` 递增 intent；随后将旧 pending/leased job 置为 `superseded`，把旧 active generation 退休，并把该 row 设为 `eligible=0`、`activeGeneration=null`，见 [projection-store.ts](</C:/Users/27933/.codex/worktrees/project-rag-longterm-20261109/ClawX/openclaw_runtime/src/knowledge/retrieval/projection-store.ts:545>) 和 [projection-store.ts](</C:/Users/27933/.codex/worktrees/project-rag-longterm-20261109/ClawX/openclaw_runtime/src/knowledge/retrieval/projection-store.ts:573>)。

已有同 row 断言是 [projection-store.test.ts](</C:/Users/27933/.codex/worktrees/project-rag-longterm-20261109/ClawX/openclaw_runtime/src/knowledge/retrieval/projection-store.test.ts:183>)：同一 subject 改变 revision、digest 和 locator 后，断言 `sourceKey` 不变、`sources("ns-1")` 只有一行、旧 generation 全部 retired。现有 restart 端到端测试 [project-rag-index-recovery.test.ts](</C:/Users/27933/.codex/worktrees/project-rag-longterm-20261109/ClawX/tests/unit/project-rag-index-recovery.test.ts:43>) 已覆盖停止期间写入后重启并检索。就这轮修复结论，不需要再补新的 restart same-row 断言；如果要把“重启后仍只有一行”作为独立产品级断言，再在 restart 测试中加 `sources` 行数/eligible 检查即可。
